assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high resolution cinematic photorealistic compositing asset for a Chinese mythological interactive cosmic scene, isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Full body of Pangu, the primordial giant, three-quarter frontal view, facing slightly left, standing with weight planted, both hands holding a massive archaic stone axe diagonally overhead, ready to cleave the sky. Readable axe head, anatomically plausible hands and limbs, solemn ancient East Asian male face in deep shadow, long flowing dark hair, primitive weathered woven and stone ornaments, a dark draped skirt covering the waist and thighs. Silhouette is powerful and simple, NOT a game armor character, no bright gold armor. Most of the body is graphite black stone-like darkness with a very narrow champagne-gold rim light outlining head, shoulders, arms and axe. Subtle ancient bronze and rock surface details only, restrained film lighting. Composition: entire figure AND axe comfortably inside frame with 12 percent transparent margin, portrait aspect ratio. No ground, no fog, no scenery, no halo, no stars, no background, no border, no text. Beautiful tangible material and anatomy, quiet monumental presence, not cartoon. Output transparent PNG.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE cinematic realistic mythological compositing asset of Nuwa for an elegant Chinese cosmic sky-weaving interactive scene, genuinely transparent alpha background, portrait framing. Ancient East Asian goddess in a quiet three-quarter SIDE profile, looking upward toward the upper LEFT. Long flowing ivory and desaturated pale-jade silk robes, subtle ancient jade ornament in black hair, no elaborate crown, a calm compassionate face. Her upper body and two arms clearly visible: one hand extends toward upper left with palm open and fingers gently cupped, the other hand gathers a fold of silk near the waist. Anatomically natural detailed hands. The open palm must be at approximately 25 percent image width, 32 percent image height; face approximately 53 percent width, 22 percent height. Entire arms, fingertips, robe and hair fully in frame with transparent margins. A very delicate pearl and jade rimlight along sleeve and fingertips, mostly softly shadowed, tasteful cinematic realism, NOT a game splash screen, no saturated neon, no purple. Bottom robe gently trails diagonally right; lower hem can softly taper into transparency. No magical effects, no floating stones, no clouds, no stars, no moon, no background, no text. Separate alpha PNG asset intended to sit behind moving translucent clouds, at a subtle scale, not a poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single elegant, dreamlike celestial nebula compositing asset on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, wide landscape 3:2. A delicate long S-curving river of luminous cosmic mist, like translucent silk floating weightlessly in a quiet night sky. Graceful fine wisps and layered gossamer folds, pale silver, pearl white, icy powder blue, faint aqua, just a whisper of soft champagne starlight at the heart. The main current sweeps gently from lower left toward upper right, with a relaxed open curl around the center-right, large transparent breathing spaces. Many extremely fine pinpoint stars embedded inside the airy gas, a few tiny jewel-like highlights, no thick opaque black dust lanes, no hard boundaries, no solar disk, no rings, no rocky texture, no stone, no figure, no spacecraft, no lens flare spikes, no neon, no purple saturation, no text or graphic elements. Ethereal and beautiful, refined cinematic fantasy sky, soft and luminous with crisp microscopic stars, not aggressive or explosive. Keep the light veil thin enough for a web interface to remain legible over it. Outer clouds smoothly feather to FULLY TRANSPARENT, not a black rectangular sky. Output alpha PNG.
